summary: Controlled filter editor for defining an audience segment.
whenToUse: Composing audience criteria that remain managed by the consumer app.
whenNotToUse: Saving segments or querying an audience: persistence is external.

keyboard.action: Edit fields through Select, TextField and Button.

accessibility: Every input has a visible label.
Selections are provided by the system's accessible components.
customization: Composed with Select, TextField and Button; --dc-* tokens.
commonMistakes: Expecting the component to save or run the filters.
